title: The Original 100 Handbag: Why It Will Always Be Your Favorite
summary: Every brand has a beginning. Ours just happened to give way to a bag that became a forever favorite. The Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag wasn’t designed to be iconic. It was designed to be carried every day, everywhere by women who had places to go and no interest in carrying something boring to get there. It was practical without looking practical. Pretty without trying too hard. Structured, but still soft enough to feel lived-in from day one. And maybe that’s why it stuck. This wasn’t just another Vera Bradley handbag. It was the one that proved you could have thoughtful organization, a timeless shape, and personality all in one bag. That’s exactly what makes it unforgettable! Why It Still Works (And Always Will) The Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag isn’t trying to reinvent itself every season. It doesn’t need to. The proportions are right. The shape is right. The details are right. It’s roomy enough for what you actually carry, compact enough to never feel bulky. It’s the kind of bag you grab without thinking twice because you already know it works. Its handle drop is long enough to sit comfortably on your shoulder, yet easy to carry without the need for constant adjusting or tucking it under your arm. It’s subtle, but those details matter. You feel them in the way the bag moves with you. Plenty of Pockets for Everything You Need Every Day We’ve always believed a bag should make your day smoother, not more chaotic. Inside the Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag you’ll find five interior slip pockets. That means your phone isn’t hiding under your sunglasses and your keys aren’t always at the bottom of the bag. All of your essentials have a place. On the outside, you’ll find two slip pockets for the things you reach for constantly, like your phone, ID badge, or lip balm. And the zip closure keeps everything secure without ruining the clean lines of the bag. It’s a practical design made by people who actually carry handbags. Different Decades. Same Good Taste. The Original 100 Handbag was launched by Vera Bradley founders Patricia R. Miller and Barbara Bradley Baekgaard in 1982, back when bags were bland and colorful patterns were seldom found. Adding colorful patterns and prints to tote bags was a bold move that many found joyful. Although the Original 100 Handbag has plenty of history, it doesn’t feel stuck in the past. A new generation is discovering the Vera Bradley handbag that started it all. And they’re styling it their own way. With vintage denim, tailored blazers, sneakers, heels, or whatever feels right today. It works all of these looks because it doesn’t dictate. It’s not about nostalgia. It’s about confidence. It’s The Details That Matter Now that you know the vibe, let’s get into the specifics of this classic bag. What are the Dimensions of the Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag? It measures 11" wide x 5 ¾” high x 5 ¾” deep. It’s compact but roomy enough for your daily essentials. What is the Handle Drop? The handle drop is 13 ½”, making it easy to carry comfortably on your shoulder. How Many Pockets Does It Have? You’ll find five interior slip pockets for organization inside and two exterior slip pockets for quick-access items. It also features a zip closure to keep everything contained and secure while maintaining its classic silhouette. Is This a Good Everyday Bag? That’s exactly what it was designed for. It’s structured enough to look polished, practical enough to handle your real life, and timeless enough to carry for years. Plus, the bag is made with our signature quilted cotton which is durable and machine washable, all while looking great for years. The Original 100 Handbag: Fits Your Life and Not Just Your Outfit Trends are fun. We love them. But favorites? Favorites are different. Favorites are the bags you reach for without thinking. The ones that already know your routine. The ones that somehow look better the more you carry them. The Vera Bradley Original 100 Handbag isn’t trying to be the loudest bag in the room. It wants to be the one you trust. SHOP THE ORIGINAL 100 HANDBAG
